settings.heading: Small range. Straight answers.
settings.text: We keep a deliberately short list of everyday tech and show you everything up front: live stock, the full price and how fast it ships.

settings.heading: The full range
settings.subheading: [count] products, numbered and in one place. Nothing hidden behind filters or pages.
settings.close_text: Tell us the device you need it to work with and we'll tell you honestly whether anything here fits.

settings.heading: On sale now
settings.subheading: Reduced prices, with the original price shown on every item.

settings.heading: Chosen, not listed
settings.statement: Most tech stores list everything a supplier offers. We'd rather keep a short range of things people use every day, and be straight about each one.

settings.title: A short range on purpose
settings.text: Charging, audio, small appliances and wearables. If we wouldn't use it ourselves, it doesn't go on the list.

settings.title: Stock you can see
settings.text: Stock levels come from our inventory and update as orders come in, so in stock means we can send it.

settings.title: The full price, up front
settings.text: Delivery options and costs for your address are shown at checkout before you pay. No account needed to order.

settings.heading: After you order
settings.subheading: What happens between checkout and your door, and what's covered after.

settings.title: Order from live stock
settings.text: Every product page shows its current stock before you buy, and backorders are marked.

settings.title: Packed and dispatched
settings.text: In-stock orders leave within 1-2 business days. Weekend orders go out the next business day.

settings.title: Tracking by email
settings.text: We email a tracking number when your order ships.

settings.title: Covered
settings.text: 30 days to return unused items, and a 12-month warranty against defects from normal use.

settings.question: Will it work in my country?
settings.answer: Check the product details for plug type, voltage and compatibility. If anything is unclear, ask us before you order.

settings.question: How much is shipping?
settings.answer: Delivery options and prices for your address are shown at checkout, before you pay.

settings.question: What if it arrives faulty?
settings.answer: Send your order number and a photo or video of the fault. We'll arrange a repair, replacement or refund under the 12-month warranty.

settings.heading: Still not sure?
settings.text: Questions go to a real person on our team, not a bot. Include the device you're using and we'll check compatibility.

settings.heading: Restocks and new additions, first
settings.text: One short email when something new joins the range or comes back in stock. Subscriber offers when we run them.
settings.fine_print: Unsubscribe any time. We never share your email.
